data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 510 opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,656.2m. During 2019 the syndicate recorded a net prior-year surplus of GBP 59.0m arising from reassessment of claims for previous accident years (a release). Management attributes the favourable movement primarily to favourable claims development on prior years and the benefit of reinsurance recoveries and lower-than-expected catastrophe frequency in 2019. No gross prior-year movement figure was explicitly provided in the notes (the report states the net prior-year surplus); a gross PYD figure was not located in the gross movement notes and a gross claims development triangle is present but impacted by reinsurance to close activity, so the net figure has been used as a fallback.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (GROSS provision movement for prior years) was not explicitly provided in a single gross-number movement note. The report explicitly states a NET prior year surplus of GBP 59.0m; no gross prior-year movement figure was located in the movement notes in gross 'Insurance liabilities' column. A gross claims development triangle exists (page 34) but the notes indicate RITC activity affecting the 2018 year (reinsurance to close), which can distort diagonal comparisons. Therefore the NET figure has been used as a fallback and the result flagged. Lob-level prior-year reserve movements are not given explicitly so LOB movements are inferred and have low confidence.

_claims_triangle.note: A gross claims development table is present on page 34. Due to reinsurance to close and formatting complexity the full development rows were not programmatically extracted here; the report's 'Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 59.0m ...' (net) was used as the prior-year movement fallback.
